runs.text: Read a day and a month of a year that is not a leap year, in that order. Show
(month out of range). If the month does not exist, that is the reason, even if the day is also wrong.

hints.text: How many days does each month have? Which is validated first, the day or the month?
They are the two filters in a row of
One subprogram says how many days a month has; another applies the filters and returns the reason of the first one that fails.
First the month between 1 and 12; then the day between 1 and the days of that month. Close with the variant.

runs.text: Add the year and take into account the leap years of
Hidden cases: 29 February, the edges of April and December, day 0 and a case with both values wrong, where the month rules.
